goal: Let RPC client libraries automatically map getblock verbosity levels to their expected response types
Help typed client generators avoid hardcoding result variants that cannot be told apart by payload alone
agreement: Strong support for using a discriminator over more complex alternatives (willcl-ark)
Concept approval with schema documentation and test suggestions resolved (jeanpablojp)
Unanswered question on why only getblock is discriminated rather than all RPC results (maflcko)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it provides machine-readable schema metadata for typed client libraries like corepc and btcd
Benefit is concentrated on client generators handling getblock verbosity variants
